title: Bible Story: The Call of Samuel
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells the call of Samuel (1 Samuel 3:3-10) and says the lesson: listen to God and obey.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the importance of obeying parents.
floor.question: Why should children obey their parents?
floor.answer: God commands it (it keeps us safe)

representations: a song about the call of Samuel

board.say: What did Samuel do each time?

board.do: Wait for the child to say he ran to Eli.
Write: Speak, for your servant is listening.

misconceptions.repair: Read 1 Samuel 3:8. Eli understood it was the Lord.

misconceptions.ask: How many times did Samuel run to Eli?
misconceptions.repair: Act it out with three runs.

misconceptions.ask: What did Samuel say when God called the last time?
misconceptions.repair: Say the words together with a hand to the ear.

misconceptions.ask: Was Samuel a boy or an old man when God called him?
misconceptions.repair: Show a picture of the boy Samuel. God speaks to children too.

checks.question: What is the lesson from the call of Samuel?
